title: Mail triage
idea: Mail triage: Inbox rows and a reading pane preserve conversation context
audience: People who need to triage mail within a desktop surface.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic ledger layout through its triage mail priority and explicit commitment contract: Sending requires explicit action and truthful delivery state
navigation: Mail triage keeps the current triage mail context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Inbox rows and a reading pane preserve conversation context
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to triage mail; users process a high-volume inbox
composition.priority: Sending requires explicit action and truthful delivery state

imagery.role: Support the actual triage mail context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Retain selected conversation when preview becomes a route
Respect window resizing, keyboard navigation and persistent document/workspace context.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the mail triage structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no triage mail content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Sending requires explicit action and truthful delivery state
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized triage mail content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Sending requires explicit action and truthful delivery state
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active triage mail context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure representative large documents/collections and resize interaction on target OS.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
